text:
Lina (CS): FYI — HaloHealth renewal due 2026-06-15. Saw a pretty sharp usage collapse last 30d. Need triage and an ask list before EOW.

Omar (CSM): Noted. Do we have last-30d vs prior-30d numbers?

Lina (CS): Quick snapshot I pulled from console: total API calls -71%, token usage -68%, embeddings calls -65%. Seats active from 18 -> 6. Champion Alex left two weeks ago.

Tyler (SRE): Any recent errors or auth issues? I can check logs.

Lina (CS): No error spike. Latencies normal. It's behavioral — usage simply vanished; likely stakeholder churn + parallel trial.

Sophia (RevOps): I pinged procurement contact (cfo@halohealth). They confirmed a short trial with MedlyAI last week; nothing signed yet.

Jordan (PM): Do we know what feature they're evaluating with MedlyAI? Is it embeddings/semantic search or summarization?

Lina (CS): From Slack thread they asked for a summarization demo and a 1k-doc batch embed to compare similarity quality.

Matt (Support): I have the last support ticket: "models seem cheaper elsewhere" + request for sample quantized model benchmarks.

Omar (CSM): So three pressure points: cost, champion gone, competitor trial. We should prepare (1) a short technical bake-off template, (2) a pricing flex option for 2-week trial, (3) a re-engage deck for new stakeholders.

Sophia (RevOps): I can draft a one-pager on cost comparison + recommended concession (1 month trial discount or 30% off embedding units for trial).

Tyler (SRE): For bake-off: I'll prepare a reproducible test harness. Quick plan: provide a sanitized dataset (1k docs), a notebook with steps, and identical prompts. I can include perf/latency and quality metric snippets (cosine sims + MRR).

Jordan (PM): Add an eval checklist: reproducibility, seed prompts, metric definitions, example expected outputs. We should call out KV cache and batching differences as part of perf profile.

Lina (CS): Proposed outreach: 1) Offer 2-week prod-like trial on Dedicated-lite (isolated, predictable perf) with discounted embedding units; 2) Run a 1-hour technical session with Tyler + product to walk the bake-off; 3) Reintroduce internal champion list (CTO, Head of ML, Procurement). Thoughts?

Omar (CSM): Good. I'll own the outreach. Lina, can you share an updated stake map? I last had Alex (former champion), Priya (Procurement), and Mark (CTO) listed. Who else?

Lina (CS): Updated list: Priya (procurement), Mark (CTO), Hannah (Head of Data Eng) — new contact from last meeting. I'll add their emails.

Matt (Support): On the sample bench: here's a quick snippet I can run and share as a gist: 
```
# run embeddings batch
python tools/bench.py --dataset halo_1k.json --model rwd-embed-compact --batch-size 64
```
I can attach perf numbers by EOD.

Tyler (SRE): For Dedicated-lite setup I need a signed trial agreement (security/SLA waiver). Sophia, can you flag legal?

Sophia (RevOps): Filing a quick approval. We can use the standard trial waiver; I have a template.

Jordan (PM): Recommend we also capture quality regression tests so halohealth can compare outputs objectively — precision@k, average cosine gap, and a couple of manual spot checks.

Lina (CS): Agreed. Omar, schedule the session for next Tue/Wed. Target deliverables before the call: bake-off harness, cost one-pager, trial terms, and stakeholder invite.

Omar (CSM): On it. Tentative invite sent for Tue 11am PT.

deploy-bot: Deployment finished: bench harness repo updated at commit abc123.

Tyler (SRE): I pushed the harness and sample logs to the shared folder: /shared/halohealth/bakeoff/. Link: https://redwood.internal/halo/bakeoff

Lina (CS): Thanks team. One risk note — if competitor shows parity on quality and materially lower list price, we should be ready with a short-term retention credit + a 2-week dedicated performance SLA. Sophia, prep pricing language.

Sophia (RevOps): Will do. Draft ready by EOD for review.

Jordan (PM): I'll prepare a 7-slide technical summary for the session showing why our runtime preserves latency at scale (KV cache, batching, kernel selection).

Omar (CSM): Final ask: capture the customer's success metric for the POC. Lina, can you confirm (likely "reduce time-to-insight on patient docs" + "precision@5 >= 0.75").

Lina (CS): Confirmed. I'll update the invite with target success metrics.

Matt (Support): I'll standby for any quick logs or repro steps during the trial.

Lina (CS): Great — action items owned. We'll reconvene after the bake-off and adjust renewal playbook. :white_check_mark:

Omar (CSM): Thanks all.
